# Joffrey Long / SouthwestDirect.com

> Direct hard-money lender for California real estate investors. Southwest
> Bancorp funds 100% of its loans with its own money and services them in
> house, so a borrower speaks with the decision-maker rather than an
> intermediary. Typical closing is 5–12 days.

Southwest Bancorp, doing business as Joffrey Long / SouthwestDirect.com, is a
licensed California real estate broker and portfolio lender based in Irvine.
Joffrey Long has been a hard-money lender for more than 43 years and sits on the
board of directors of the California Mortgage Association.

## Contact

## Services

Hard-money and private-money real estate lending in California only, to real
estate investors and business owners for investment or business purposes.

- Property types: residential rental (1–4 and 5–15 units), automotive and
  service centers, mixed use, industrial and warehouse, houses of worship,
  truck parking lots and other specialty properties
- Terms: interest-only over 2, 4, 5 or 7 years; fully amortised over 15 or 20
  years; with or without early payoff fees; cross-collateral for a lower down
  payment
- Credit and income problems, damaged or incomplete properties, low rents and
  legal non-conforming or zoning issues are all considered
- Loan brokers: the borrower stays the broker's client, and fees are paid from
  escrow or directly, the broker's choice

Not offered: loans outside California, vacant land unless it produces rental
income, and rural or very small communities. Southwest Bancorp does not fund
consumer-purpose loans secured by 1–4 family residences.
